title: From Distributional to Overton Pluralism: Investigating Large Language Model Alignment
reasoning: The paper investigates 'Overton pluralism' and 'value pluralism' in LLMs, examining how alignment affects the representation of diverse human values and perspectives. It uses datasets like CONFLICTINGQA, which includes questions on controversial societal and religious topics (e.g., Noah's Ark), and evaluates the models' pluralistic stances and viewpoint diversity.
